en.headline: Man arrested after Yuen Long rooftop standoff following alleged assault
en.dek: Police detained a 39-year-old man on suspicion of wounding after he was persuaded from a rooftop on Kik Yeung Road, where a woman had been injured earlier.
body: Police arrested a 39-year-old man on suspicion of wounding after a rooftop standoff in Yuen Long on Thursday morning.

Emergency services were called at about 10:38 a.m. to a building at 1-5 Kik Yeung Road, where the man was seen seated on the rooftop edge and holding a knife at one point. Negotiators engaged with him and persuaded him back to safety shortly before 11:30 a.m.

Inquiries indicated that the man had argued earlier with a woman he had recently met. In the early hours he is alleged to have used a sharp object to injure her neck and hand before going to the rooftop and calling police himself. Officers found the 50-year-old woman conscious in a lower-floor flat at the same address; she was taken by ambulance to Tuen Mun Hospital for treatment.
Police sealed parts of the building for examination while the investigation continues.

zh.headline: 元朗男子危坐天台後被捕 涉傷人
zh.dek: 警方在擊壤路勸服一名39歲男子離開天台後，以涉嫌傷人拘捕他；一名50歲女子較早時頸手受傷送院。
body: 周四早上元朗發生傷人及天台危坐事件，警方其後拘捕一名39歲男子，涉嫌傷人。
約上午10時38分，救援人員接報一名男子危坐於擊壤路1至5號大廈天台，一度持刀，懷疑企圖尋短。談判專家到場遊說，至近11時半男子被勸服返回安全位置。
警方調查顯示，該男子早前與一名新相識的女子爭執，凌晨時分疑持利器傷及對方頸部和手部，其後登上天台並自行報警。警員在大廈低層單位尋獲該名50歲女子，她當時清醒，由救護車送往屯門醫院治理。
警方已封鎖相關樓層調查，案件仍在跟進中。
